report.root_cause: Region file world/region/r.0.0.mca had one corrupt chunk entry at chunk (1,0): decompression failed (zlib "incorrect header check"). On load, Paper logged "Failed to load chunk data ... chunk data will be lost". The cause of the on-disk corruption was not determined from available logs. The corrupt entry was last written at 05:50:30.
report.actions: Checked status (TPS 20, healthy) and logs; grep ERROR showed the chunk read failure for chunk (1,0) in world 'world'. Inspected world/region/r.0.0.mca: 360 chunks ok, chunk 1,0 corrupt. Found backup backups/world-2026-10-31/region/r.0.0.mca with chunk 1,0 ok (saved 05:50:04). Declared incident. Stopped server (world saved on stop). After stop, r.0.0.mca showed chunk 1,0 as ok but saved 08:05:37, meaning the shutdown save had overwritten the corrupt entry with the server's in-memory copy, not the original player data. Restored only chunk (1,0) via copy_chunk from the backup into world/region/r.0.0.mca; other chunks untouched. Re-inspected: 400 chunks, 0 corrupt, chunk 1,0 saved 05:50:04. Started server. Verified via status (TPS 20, MSPT about 0.6, 2 players online) and logs (no ERROR lines after restart, no chunk load failures). Watched about 3.5 minutes.
report.residual_risk: Chunk (1,0) was restored from the 05:50:04 backup, so changes made in that chunk between 05:50:04 and the corruption at 05:50:30 are not present. Players who built in that chunk should be checked for missing work. Only r.0.0.mca was inspected; the other region files had no load errors in the logs but were not inspected in depth. The root cause of the original corruption is unknown and could recur. The stop/start disconnected both players, who reconnected.
